title: picocli does not register defaultValueProvider references thus breaks in native
body:
### Describe the bug

Have something like:

```
@CommandLine.Command(name = "starfix", mixinStandardHelpOptions = true, defaultValueProvider = YAMLDefaultProvider.class)
```

then if you do not add `@RegisterForReflection` you get an error like:
